title: PPO net2 on net1 v5, search stage 2: learning rate, K and the training mix
description: Stage 2 of the PPO net2 search on validation (stage 1: exp-net2-ppo-search1-90). Stage 1 kept, by its stated rule (the best last evaluation), tau = 1 s and sigma = 0.05 (+0.014 against the rule; every cell within about 0.03 of it). Its cells all moved toward a lower constant u at a speed growing with sigma, gaining alone and losing against Cubic: the training mix (competition on half the links, split evenly over Cubic, BBR and 2, 3 or 4 copies) favours a lower u, and no cell learned to tell competition apart (spread of u across states 0.015 to 0.037). Here, at tau = 1 s and sigma = 0.05: learning rate 1e-4, 3e-4 or 1e-3, by K = 2 or 4 rollouts per link (32 rollouts per iteration either way), by the mix: stage 1's, or competition on 80% of the links split evenly over Cubic, BBR and 2 copies. 40 iterations each, evaluated noise-free every 10 and at the start on the validation links' new-conditions family, paired by link with the rule. The stage keeps the cell with the best last evaluation; its training is then repeated over three seeds and checked on all validation families (the gate on 11-11). Validation links only.
run: S="$OUT/spec-lr$LR-k$K-$MIX.json"; jq --argjson lr "$LR" --argjson k "$K" --arg mix "$MIX" '.tau_s = 1 | .noise_sigma = 0.05 | .lr = $lr | .group = $k | .links_per_iteration = (32 / $k) | .iterations = 40 | .eval_every = 10 | if $mix == "compete" then .compete = 0.8 | .copies = [2] else . end' "$OUT/setup/ppo-base.json" > "$S"; uv run expliccit train ppo "$S" "$OUT/ppo-lr$LR-k$K-$MIX" --build "$UML" --workers "$WORKERS"
